title: Deterministic evaluation: exact match, format and rules

videos.script: From here the course stops watching the assistant and starts grading it. {{grade}} The first kind of grading needs no judgement, only a rule a program can apply. You have met it already: every exercise on this platform is marked that way. {{platform}} Thirty questions with their answers, and the assistant's replies to them. Sixteen are right. Loosening the comparison changes nothing, because no normalisation reaches a paraphrase. {{facts}} Then rules every reply should obey: cite every sentence, cite only real sources, take every number from a source, repeat nothing personal. {{rules}} They cost nothing, so they run on every reply. On this assistant, none of them ever fires. {{zero}} And every wrong answer passed them. A reply about the wrong kind of delivery has perfect form. {{form}} Rules see the form. Seeing the meaning takes something that reads. {{end}}
